copy.summary: Bare 12 mm encoder with a push switch
copy.wiringNote: No supply pin. Wire C and one switch leg each to ground; A, B and SW go to GPIOs, which always use the internal pull-up. Each click is two transitions rather than four, which the firmware counts as one click like the module.
